title: Read-only versus mutating retry
description: Compare a safe-to-repeat read operation with a side-effecting write operation.
assumptions: Read is truly side-effect free; write may change state.

expected.handling: Do not apply one blanket retry rule to both operations; evaluate read purity and write commit status.

failure_modes: Assuming all tool calls are safe to retry
Ignoring hidden side effects in nominal reads
notes: A read may still have billing, rate-limit, or audit effects.
